name: Zetrix Agentic Wallet
description: Zetrix identity, verifiable-credential and pay-per-use wallet tools for agents.

network.label: Zetrix network
network.help: Testnet by default. Mainnet spends real funds.

maxPaymentAmount.label: Maximum payment per call
maxPaymentAmount.help: Maximum per payment, in the token's raw units. Simplest form is one limit for everything: {"*":"1000000000"}. To limit per token, use "ZTX" for the native coin and either the token ticker (e.g. "JMYR") or its contract address — if you write both, the contract address wins. Leave this EMPTY to use the wallet's own default, which allows exactly the AI Birthcert fee (1 JMYR) on both testnet and mainnet and refuses everything else. Note the limit applies per payment, not as a running total. To refuse every payment deliberately, name a token as well (e.g. {"*":"0","JMYR":"0"}) — a bare {"*":"0"} is read as a leftover from an older version and ignored.

zetrixAddress.label: Existing holder address (optional)
zetrixAddress.help: Leave empty and the wallet creates its own account on first run.

myidVerifyLinkTemplate.label: MyID verification link (optional)
myidVerifyLinkTemplate.help: The link create_verification_qr gives the user, with {referenceId} where the reference id goes, for example https://<MyID link domain>/<path>?referenceId={referenceId}. Must be https, printable ASCII only, with the placeholder in the path or query. The wallet checks it again when it starts and has the final say. Leave it empty on testnet: it defaults to MyID's UAT link. On mainnet there is no default until MyID's production side is verified, and until it is set the tool refuses rather than invent a link.
